name: off-automatic-recovery-after-native-compact
description: official-host.ts:1672 'automatic recovery after a native /compact excludes summarized inputs and keeps the native summary'. Two turns, a native compact (two summarization requests), then a prompt whose dump result crosses the line: the automatic record starts at the native kept tail (AFTER_COMPACT_OWNER, the native summary as 'older checkpoint; possibly stale'; ANCIENT_OWNER_REQUEST excluded) and no summary request is made for it.
